*Re: Case No. CASE-7797-177517 – Jennifer Young v. Justin Smith*  

[Date]  

[Opposing Counsel’s Name and Address]  

Dear [Opposing Counsel],  

I write on behalf of our client, **Jennifer Young**, in response to your recent correspondence regarding the above-referenced matter.  

We acknowledge receipt of your communication and are reviewing the points raised. Without waiving any rights or objections, we will provide a substantive response once we have had the opportunity to fully assess the issues with our client.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Firm]  

*Note: This letter does not disclose privileged or confidential information and is issued for response purposes only.*

**Date:** [Insert Date]
